sourceContext.subject: Reading / ELA
sourceContext.sourceLine: Reading Comprehension: ask & answer questions; main idea/details

proposedQuestions.prompt: Read: 'Our class puts paper, cans, and plastic bottles in special bins. We use these bins every school day to reduce trash.' What is the main idea?
choices: The class recycles to reduce trash.
The class puts paper in special bins.
The class puts bottles in special bins.
proposedQuestions.answer: The class recycles to reduce trash.
proposedQuestions.explanation: The two sentences explain that the class sorts several kinds of materials to reduce trash. The other options mention only individual examples.
proposedQuestions.hint: Choose the answer that includes the purpose and all kinds of recycling, not just one item.

proposedQuestions.prompt: Read: 'Bees visit many flowers. They carry pollen as they fly. This helps some plants grow.' What is the main idea?
choices: Bees carry pollen as they fly.
Bees help plants while visiting flowers.
Bees visit many flowers.
proposedQuestions.answer: Bees help plants while visiting flowers.
proposedQuestions.explanation: All the details show how bees move among flowers and help plants grow. The other options describe only one detail each.
proposedQuestions.hint: A main idea covers the whole passage; the other choices may describe smaller details.

proposedQuestions.prompt: Read: 'Milo the dog fetched his ball, practiced sitting on command, and ran around the yard.' Which title best fits the whole passage?
choices: Milo Fetches His Ball
Milo Learns to Sit
Milo Practices and Plays
proposedQuestions.explanation: The passage includes several ways Milo played and practiced skills.
proposedQuestions.hint: Find the title that includes both practicing and playing, not only one action.

proposedQuestions.prompt: Read: 'Trees shade people, give birds places to nest, and hold soil with their roots.' Which main idea fits all the details?
choices: Trees are useful in several ways.
Birds can build nests in trees.
Tree roots help hold soil in place.
proposedQuestions.answer: Trees are useful in several ways.
proposedQuestions.explanation: Shade, nesting places, and roots that hold soil are three different useful things trees provide. The other choices each mention just one detail.
proposedQuestions.hint: Which choice describes the whole group of benefits, not one example?

proposedQuestions.prompt: The main idea is 'Rain helps a garden grow.' Which supporting detail best fits this idea?
choices: Some gardens have tall fences.
Rainwater soaks the roots of flowers.
A gardener uses a shovel to make holes.
proposedQuestions.answer: Rainwater soaks the roots of flowers.
proposedQuestions.explanation: Water reaching flower roots explains how rain helps growth. The other details concern gardens but do not explain the benefit of rain.
proposedQuestions.hint: Find the fact that explains how rain gives water to the plants.

proposedQuestions.prompt: Read: 'The librarian labels shelves, arranges books by subject, and helps children find stories.' Which sentence gives the main idea rather than only one detail?
choices: The shelves have labels.
Books can be placed on shelves.
The librarian helps people find organized books.
proposedQuestions.answer: The librarian helps people find organized books.
proposedQuestions.explanation: Labels and arranging books are details that support the larger role of organizing and finding books.
proposedQuestions.hint: Pick the statement broad enough to cover the different library tasks.

proposedQuestions.prompt: Read: 'Each morning the school bus picks up students. The driver checks that everyone is seated before moving.' Which summary fits best?
choices: A bus safely carries children to school.
The bus picks up students each morning.
The driver checks that everyone is seated.
proposedQuestions.answer: A bus safely carries children to school.
proposedQuestions.explanation: The best summary connects transporting students with checking their safety. The other choices each mention one detail.
proposedQuestions.hint: Choose the big idea supported by both the pickup and the driver's safety check.

proposedQuestions.prompt: Read: 'At the beach, Maya collected shells, watched tiny crabs, and built a sandcastle.' Which sentence tells the main idea instead of one detail?
choices: Maya built a sandcastle.
Maya watched a crab.
Maya enjoyed several beach activities.
proposedQuestions.explanation: Collecting shells, watching crabs, and building a castle are details of Maya's many beach activities.
proposedQuestions.hint: Look for a statement that covers all the things Maya did.
